# Clean Data for All

> Data-journalism essays on U.S. K-12 education and global public health. Each post starts from a public dataset and finds the surprising story inside the numbers. Written by T.J. Muehleman, founder of Standard Co.

Clean Data for All publishes one or two pieces per week. Every number traces to a public dataset; every source is cited in full at the end of the post. Coverage emphasizes equity-relevant findings — what the data shows about who's improving, who's being left behind, and which policies are doing the work.

## Recent posts

- [Murders fell 21% in 2025. The data pipeline noticed before the rest of us.](https://www.cleandataforall.com/murders-fell-21-percent-2025.html): The story behind the largest one-year murder decline ever recorded — and why the data caught up before the news cycle did.
- [Mississippi went from 49th to 9th in 4th-grade reading. The fight that mattered wasn't about the score.](https://www.cleandataforall.com/mississippi-49-to-9.html): The Mississippi NAEP gain held up under demographic adjustment. The fight was about whether the gain was real.
- [Louisiana led the nation in FAFSA for 7 years — repealed the policy in 2024, dropped from 5th to 29th](https://www.cleandataforall.com/louisiana-fafsa-policy-off.html): A clean policy-on/policy-off natural experiment in a single state.
- [The average recovered. The bottom didn't.](https://www.cleandataforall.com/naep-2024-average-recovered-bottom-didnt.html): NAEP 2024 averages ticked back up — but the lowest-scoring quartile of U.S. students is still in freefall.
- [Michigan's teacher pipeline is up 87%. The national headline still says collapse.](https://www.cleandataforall.com/michigan-teacher-prep-recovery.html): Nine states are quietly recovering teacher-prep enrollment while the national narrative misses it.
- [An mpox database update found a virus we already had](https://www.cleandataforall.com/mpox-database-update.html): A December 2025 update to the Nextclade reference database retroactively reclassified a September case in India — a lesson on the limits of pathogen surveillance pipelines.
- [Arizona has three years of the best voucher data in the country](https://www.cleandataforall.com/arizona-universal-voucher-two-numbers.html): The headline number still depends on how you ask.
- [TB set two records in 2023. Both are about the data pipeline, not the disease.](https://www.cleandataforall.com/tb-two-records.html): What the WHO Global TB Report's record-setting numbers actually mean.
